mathematical_results: S007-P1 PROGRAMME LEMMA: the progressive-subsums condition is equivalent, after translation by -h, to having zero-sum subsequences of every cardinality; proof in sessions/S007/PROGRESSIVE_SUBSUMS_BRIDGE.md.
S007-P2 PROGRAMME LEMMA: any sufficiently large reflection-balanced block about h satisfies the progressive-subsums condition; proof in sessions/S007/PROGRESSIVE_SUBSUMS_BRIDGE.md.
S007-P3 PROGRAMME RESULT: D6-08 holds for m=2; Girard--Schmid 2019 Lemma 4.4(2) then yields a translated length-13 eta-extremal core.

S007-P4 PROGRAMME LEMMA: for m=3, the bridge is equivalent to a repetition or centered three-term progression. The universal m=3 case was unresolved at S007 but is covered by S008-P3 since 3 has Property D; live index corrected in S010.

S008-P1 PROGRAMME LEMMA: for every CAND-02 extremal, all eight C_2^3 quotient fibers have odd multiplicity, and every maximal same-fiber pairing yields a length-(4m-4) m-zero-sum-free extremal sequence over C_m^2.
S008-P2 PROGRAMME LEMMA: if one C_2^3 quotient fiber is non-monochromatic, two maximal same-fiber pairings yield two distinct C_m^2 EGZ-extremals sharing exactly 4m-5 terms.

S008-P3 PROGRAMME RESULT: every CAND-02 extremal either satisfies D7-01 or induces the one-change extremal obstruction of S008-P2; hence Girard--Schmid 2019 Lemma 4.1 proves D7-01 for every modulus m having Property D, and any D7-01 counterexample would force failure of Property D at that modulus.

S008-P4 PROGRAMME LEMMA: for any maximal pairing with eight quotient residual representatives R and pair-sum extremal P, every even quotient-zero residual subsequence A of length 2t with t<=m satisfies -sigma(A) notin Sigma_{m-t}(P).
S009-P1 PROGRAMME LEMMA: the nonempty even zero-sum subsets of the squarefree residual C_2^3 quotient are exactly its fourteen affine planes and the full eight-element set.

S009-P2 PROGRAMME LEMMA: comparing the two CAND residual choices gives seven delta-paired holes in Sigma_{m-2}(T), seven delta-paired holes in Sigma_{m-3}(T), and for m>=4 a full-set pair in Sigma_{m-4}(T), with the companion exclusions that cancel identified exactly.
S009-P3 PROGRAMME LEMMA: if T x and T y are distinct near-identical C_m^2 EGZ-extremals, then -(x+y) lies in Sigma_{m-2}(T), forced solely by the sharp rank-two EGZ threshold.
S009-P4 PROGRAMME REDUCTION: any D8-02 failure must realize the exact CAND-labelled double-hole package on one length-(4m-5) common core; S009 does not prove that package impossible or construct one.

S010-P1 PROGRAMME LEMMA: exact Fano incidence equations; arbitrary through-plane centers for gcd(m,6)=1 before sumset compatibility; complete center collision possible for odd-m residual lifts, impossible for even m. Residual labels alone are not a D9 counterexample.

S010-P2 PROGRAMME LEMMA: for m>=3, a rank-two EGZ-extremal with maximum multiplicity at least floor((m-1)/2), or a qualifying progressive block, is isolated under one-term changes by unconditional eta inputs. Distinct one-change extensions must both have lower multiplicity.

S010-P3 PROGRAMME RESULT: on actual CAND extremals for m>=3, D7-01 is equivalent to monochromatic quotient fibers and to some maximal pair-sum sequence reaching multiplicity floor((m-1)/2). Failure is equivalent to M_z(S)<=floor((m-1)/2)-1 for every z in H.

S010-P4 PROGRAMME OBSTRUCTION: any forced witness in an actual nonzero-delta CAND configuration yields after translation a zero-sum (2m-1)-block containing 0; its length-(6m+1) complement has no 1/2-term zero sum but has an even short zero sum, so is not an eta-extremal core.

S011-P1 PROGRAMME DIAGNOSTIC LEMMA: on the odd-fiber length-8m domain, extremality of every maximal pair-sum sequence together with all residual exclusions is equivalent to the original 2m-zero-sum prohibition; this is not a capacity lower bound.

S011-P2 PROGRAMME FAILED-MECHANISM CERTIFICATE: a concrete two-pair exchange reaches the kernel threshold only by adding an overlapping edge; its forced witness lifts to a block requiring one unused term or pair, not supplied by the argument. Under low capacities the translated complements contain short even zero sums and cannot supply eta-free cores.

S011-P3 PROGRAMME COUNTEREXAMPLE TO RELAXATION ONLY: for primes p>=19, the eight-fiber parabola sequence has length 8p, odd fibers and every M_z<=8<=floor((p-1)/2)-1, but an explicit 2p-zero sum. It is not CAND-extremal and does not refute D7 or Property D.

S012-P1 PROGRAMME LEMMA: after translating a maximum progressive block C to zero, any disjoint complement zero sum of length at most |C|+1 splices to a strictly larger progressive block; hence a putative D6-08 failure has no complement zero sum in that range.

S012-P2 PROGRAMME LEMMA: if a putative D6-08 failure has maximum progressive size c<=m-2, a maximum complement short zero sum has length m+1<=t<=2m-c-1; with d=2m-t, the remainder has no zero sum of length at most d and c+1<=d<=m-1.

S012-P3 PROGRAMME OBSTRUCTION: if d-c=1 the remainder has eta(G)-1 terms but is not shown eta-free; if d-c>=2, eta forces only a zero sum of length at least d+1>=c+2, outside the proved splice range. A local c+2 example falsifies the overbroad splice claim, not D6-08.
S014-P1 PROGRAMME LEMMA: for every CAND-02 extremal S with n=2m, exact EGZ-threshold extension gives Sigma_{n-1}(S)=G_m and, by complementation, Sigma_{3n+1}(S)=G_m.

S014-P2 PROGRAMME LEMMA: for each support value a, every (n-1)-term representation of -a uses every old occurrence of a; after deleting all r copies, the remaining block has exact length n-r-1 and sum (n-r-1)a.

S014-P3 PROGRAMME THEOREM: the positional core K_x of all (n-1)-term representations of -x exactly classifies one-position replacements S_{p->x} that remain n-zero-sum-free. Each K_x has size at most n-1; support-a positions lie in K_a.

S014-P4 PROGRAMME COROLLARY: no support value has multiplicity n-2=2m-2; multiplicity n-3 forces a non-a pair summing to 2a, multiplicity n-1 gives a unique representation, and general r<=n-3 forces a translated support-deleted zero sum of exact length n-r-1.

S015-P1 PROGRAMME THEOREM: if p in K_x(S) has value b, safe replacement p->x transports R_x(S) bijectively to R_b(S_{p->x}) and transports the core exactly. Consequently every K_x(S) is a union of complete support value classes; the augmented core value-multiset is invariant under safe exchange.

S015-P2 PROGRAMME COROLLARY: a nontrivial support incidence b->a forces v_a(S)<=n-4, v_b(S)<=n-3 and v_a(S)+v_b(S)<=n-1. Thus multiplicity n-3 is isolated as well as n-1, while n-2 is forbidden. Deleting each source occurrence forces an exact one-step shorter support-deleted translated zero sum.

S015-P3 PROGRAMME THEOREM: for a safe move deleting value b at p and inserting x, the common deletion star Sp^{-1} has an (n-2)-term representation of -(x+b), and every such representation contains K_x(S)\{p}.

S015-P4 PROGRAMME LEMMA: each representation family factors into its fixed core plus a residual family of deficit delta_x=n-1-|K_x| with empty positional intersection. Delta zero gives a unique representation; delta one gives an equal-valued reservoir of at least two positions outside the core; delta two is the first unresolved near-full stratum.

S016-P1 PROGRAMME THEOREM: for a support core K_a of deficit delta, adjoining a fresh a gives U=MO with M=K_a a_*; every deletion of a token of M is extremal, its corresponding replacement core is M minus that token, all target representations share one residual family on O, and M is exactly the intersection of all n-term zero sums in U.

S016-P2 PROGRAMME COROLLARY: near-full deficits have exact threshold-star normal forms. Delta zero gives a unique n-zero-sum M; delta one gives M plus one term from a single equal-valued outside reservoir; delta two gives M plus an edge of a fixed-sum positional graph whose value-class components and empty-intersection cases are classified.

S016-P3 PROGRAMME LEMMA: in the deletion-star normalization, every S015-P3 common-deletion witness is exactly the forced two-token core deletion plus a member of the same residual family; it provides no independent near-full residual constraint.

S016-P4 PROGRAMME THEOREM/OBSTRUCTION: deficit descent yields |Y|=delta+|X| and sigma(Y)-sigma(X)=q+u-t. Thus a near-full nontrivial star must realize either a shifted outside residual or a cross-boundary exchange; the current ambient theorems exclude neither, so existence/nonexistence of delta<=2 remains unresolved.

S017-P1 PROGRAMME RESULT: when n=2m is a power of two, Gao--Geroldinger 2007 with kappa=2 gives 1+N_n(U)+N_2n(U)+N_3n(U)+N_4n(U)=0 mod 4 and the corresponding deletion congruence with N_n(U tau^{-1})=0 for every common-core token tau.

S017-P2 PROGRAMME COROLLARY: on the same 2-primary class, every tau in M satisfies N_n(U)+A_2n(tau)+A_3n(tau)+A_4n(tau)=0 mod 4; summing gives I_2n+I_3n+I_4n=delta N_n(U) mod 4, tying the exact S016 delta 0/1/2 counts to higher-length common-core incidence.
S017-P3 PROGRAMME COROLLARY: Gao--Geroldinger p=2 total-count divisibility implies that the number of all zero-sum subsequences of U containing any fixed tau in M is divisible by 8.

S017-P4 PROGRAMME BOUNDARY: no S017 source transfers these p-group recurrences to arbitrary mixed-primary n, and the uncontrolled 2n/3n incidences prevent exclusion of delta 0/1/2. The new dependency is exact but incomplete.
S018-P1 PROGRAMME LEMMA: exact complement/deletion/double-deletion identities express higher-length incidence as prescribed-sum counts on deletions; the 4n layer is explicit from sigma(U).
S018-P2 PROGRAMME RESULT: on n a power of two, every position x satisfies A_3n(x)=A_n(x) mod 2 and A_2n(x)=A_4n(x) mod 2, while the universal mod-4 point relation leaves one binary 2n/3n split bit.
